text: 创业板指跌超1%，沪指跌0.35%，深成指跌0.7%，风电设备、贵金属、军工、农业等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超3800只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 1%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.35%, and the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.7%, with wind power equipment, precious metals, military industry, agriculture and other sectors among the biggest decliners. More than 3,800 stocks fell across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets.
